name: Hellschreiber (Feld Hell)
description: Hellschreiber inside Kainos: Feld Hell, Slow Hell, Hell x5, Hell x9, FSK-Hell 245, FSK-Hell 105 and Hell 80, compatible with fldigi. Click a signal on the waterfall and its text is drawn as it arrives (twice, so one copy is always whole); type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
